body: Sheffield & Hallamshire Women and Girls League
note: The league follows the FA handbook for mini-soccer with no kick-off changes. Only pitch size can differ locally. The game draws the largest allowed pitch.

pitch.penaltyArea.source: Drawn because Rich's pitches always have one. Rich set the depth to end on the dot row 7.5 yards out (26th November 2026). Not checked against the FA handbook.

goalKick.bothTeamsOwnHalf.source: Rich's club rule (27th November 2026): at a goal kick both teams must be in their own half. The FA retreat line itself only names the other team.
